lines.translation: Please shower me with Your Mercy, O Lord God!
I have given up my excessive cleverness and scheming,
and I have taken the support of the Saints as my mind's support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਛਾਰੁ ਕੀ ਪੁਤਰੀ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhaar kee putaree param gat paaee ||
lines.translation: Even a puppet of ashes attains the supreme status,
O Nanak, if it has the help and support of the Saints. ||23||
Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਰ ਜੁਲਮ ਫੂਲਹਿ ਘਨੋ ਕਾਚੀ ਦੇਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: jor julam phoolahi ghano kaachee deh bikaar ||
lines.translation: Practicing oppression and tyranny, he puffs himself up; he acts in corruption with his frail, perishable body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਪਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਛੁਟਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aha(n)budh ba(n)dhan pare naanak naam chhutaar ||1||
lines.translation: He is bound by his egotistical intellect; O Nanak, salvation comes only through the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
Pauree:
JAJJA: When someone, in his ego, believes that he has become something,
he is caught in his error, like a parrot in a trap.
When he believes, in his ego, that he is a devotee and a spiritual teacher,
then, in the world hereafter, the Lord of the Universe shall have no regard for him at all.
When he believes himself to be a preacher,
he is merely a peddler wandering over the earth.
But one who conquers his ego in the Company of the Holy,
O Nanak, meets the Lord. ||24||
Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਝਾਲਾਘੇ ਉਠਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਆਰਾਧਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jhaalaaghe uth naam jap nis baasur aaraadh ||
lines.translation: Rise early in the morning, and chant the Naam; worship and adore the Lord, night and day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਰ੍ਹਾ ਤੁਝੈ ਨ ਬਿਆਪਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਟੈ ਉਪਾਧਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kaarhaa tujhai na biaapaee naanak mitai upaadh ||1||
lines.translation: Anxiety shall not afflict you, O Nanak, and your misfortune shall vanish. ||1||
Pauree:
JHAJHA: Your sorrows shall depart,
when you deal with the Lord's Name.
The faithless cynic dies in sorrow and pain;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਹੋਤ ਭਾਉ ਬੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai ridai hot bhaau beeaa ||
lines.translation: his heart is filled with the love of duality.
Your evil deeds and sins shall fall away, O my mind,
listening to the ambrosial speech in the Society of the Saints.
Sexual desire, anger and wickedness fall away,
O Nanak, from those who are blessed by the Mercy of the Lord of the World. ||25||
Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਞਤਨ ਕਰਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਧਿ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਮੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: njatan karahu tum anik bidh rahan na paavahu meet ||
lines.translation: You can try all sorts of things, but you still cannot remain here, my friend.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਰਹਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jeevat rahahu har har bhajahu naanak naam pareet ||1||
lines.translation: But you shall live forevermore, O Nanak, if you vibrate and love the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||
Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਞੰਞਾ ਞਾਣਹੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਸਹੀ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਤ ਏਹ ਹੇਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: nja(n)njaa njaanahu driR sahee binas jaat eh het ||
lines.translation: NYANYA: Know this as absolutely correct, that that this ordinary love shall come to an end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਣਤੀ ਗਣਉ ਨ ਗਣਿ ਸਕਉ ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਰੇ ਕੇਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: ganatee ganau na gan sakau ooth sidhaare ket ||
lines.translation: You may count and calculate as much as you want, but you cannot count how many have arisen and departed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਞੋ ਪੇਖਉ ਸੋ ਬਿਨਸਤਉ ਕਾ ਸਿਉ ਕਰੀਐ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: njo pekhau so binasatau kaa siu kareeai sa(n)g ||
lines.translation: Whoever I see shall perish. With whom should I associate?

lines.gurmukhi: ਞਾਣਹੁ ਇਆ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਹੀ ਚਿਤ ਝੂਠਉ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: njaanahu iaa bidh sahee chit jhoothau maaiaa ra(n)g ||
lines.translation: Know this as true in your consciousness, that the love of Maya is false.

lines.gurmukhi: ਞਾਣਤ ਸੋਈ ਸੰਤੁ ਸੁਇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਤੇ ਕੀਚਿਤ ਭਿੰਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: njaanat soee sa(n)t sui bhram te keechit bhi(n)n ||
lines.translation: He alone knows, and he alone is a Saint, who is free of doubt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਤਿਹ ਕਢਹੁ ਜਿਹ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dh koop te tih kadhahu jih hovahu suprasa(n)n ||
lines.translation: He is lifted up and out of the deep dark pit; the Lord is totally pleased with him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਞਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਤੇ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨੈ ਜੋਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: njaa kai haath samarath te kaaran karanai jog ||
lines.translation: God's Hand is All-powerful; He is the Creator, the Cause of causes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਉ ਞਾਹੂ ਕੀਓ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥੨੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tih usatat karau njaahoo keeo sa(n)jog ||26||
lines.translation: O Nanak, praise the One, who joins us to Himself. ||26||
Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਟੂਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਸਾਧ ਸੇਵ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: toote ba(n)dhan janam maran saadh sev sukh paai ||
lines.translation: The bondage of birth and death is broken and peace is obtained, by serving the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਬੀਸਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak manahu na beesarai gun nidh gobid raai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, may I never forget from my mind, the Treasure of Virtue, the Sovereign Lord of the Universe. ||1||
Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਟਹਲ ਕਰਹੁ ਤਉ ਏਕ ਕੀ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tahal karahu tau ek kee jaa te brithaa na koi ||
lines.translation: Work for the One Lord; no one returns empty-handed from Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਹੀਐ ਬਸੈ ਜੋ ਚਾਹਹੁ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan mukh heeai basai jo chaahahu so hoi ||
lines.translation: When the Lord abides within your mind, body, mouth and heart, then whatever you desire shall come to pass.

lines.gurmukhi: ਟਹਲ ਮਹਲ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸਾਧ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: tahal mahal taa kau milai jaa kau saadh kripaal ||
lines.translation: He alone obtains the Lord's service, and the Mansion of His Presence, unto whom the Holy Saint is compassionate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਤਉ ਬਸੈ ਜਉ ਆਪਨ ਹੋਹਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)gat tau basai jau aapan hohi daiaal ||
lines.translation: He joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, only when the Lord Himself shows His Mercy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਟੋਹੇ ਟਾਹੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਵਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tohe taahe bahu bhavan bin naavai sukh naahi ||
lines.translation: I have searched and searched, across so many worlds, but without the Name, there is no peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਟਲਹਿ ਜਾਮ ਕੇ ਦੂਤ ਤਿਹ ਜੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: talahi jaam ke doot tih j saadhoo sa(n)g samaahi ||
lines.translation: The Messenger of Death retreats from those who dwell in the Saadh Sangat.
Again and again, I am forever devoted to the Saints.
O Nanak, my sins from so long ago have been erased. ||27||
Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਠਾਕ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਤਿਨਹੁ ਦਰਿ ਜਿਹ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: thaak na hotee tinahu dar jih hovahu suprasa(n)n ||
lines.translation: Those beings, with whom the Lord is thoroughly pleased, meet with no obstacles at His Door.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਧਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jo jan prabh apune kare naanak te dhan dha(n)n ||1||
lines.translation: Those humble beings whom God has made His own, O Nanak, are blessed, so very blessed. ||1||
